topic: Blackbeard's Drum Island raid was a hunt for Chopper's Human-Human Fruit, and chapter 1177's Monster Point reversal is the payoff
title: Blackbeard Raided Drum For Chopper's Fruit
description: Why did Blackbeard raid Drum Island before the Straw Hats arrived? Chapter 1177's Monster Point punch makes me think it was about Chopper's fruit. My read, not canon. Do you buy it?
comment: Did Blackbeard raid Drum Island for Chopper's fruit, or just for doctors and supplies? Pick one.

lines.text: Chapter 1177 may have answered why Blackbeard raided Drum Island.
